runs.text:
We’re excited to announce that Rick is bringing his spectacular Swinging Christmas show back to London’s iconic Royal Albert Hall on 9th December 2026! 🎄✨
 
Pre-sale begins tomorrow, Wednesday 23rd September, at 10am BST.Sign up for pre-sale access:

General sale begins Friday 25th September at 10am BST.

Let’s swing into Christmas together!

Team Rick
